records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2024, product sales decreased by $73.9 million, or 11.0%, to $595.3 million, compared to $669.2 million for the three months ended March 31, 2023, due to a decrease in average selling prices and a decrease in total volume sold of 4.6%.

records.text: As a commodity, the price of home heating oil is generally impacted by many factors, including economic and geopolitical forces and is closely linked to the price of diesel fuel.
